in_arabic.name: مُراقِب
in_arabic.long_meaning: المُراقِبُ مِنَ الأَعيُنِ الَّذِي يَنْظُرُ بِها إِلَى كُلِّ شَيءٍ وَيَخْطَطُ إِلى كُلِّ مَصيرٍ وَيُقَدِّرُ مِنَ القَدرِ، وَهُوَ أَعظَمُ مِنَ العِدَلِ وَأَعَلُّ مِنَ الأَقدارِ، وَهُوَ الرَحمانُ الَّذِي يُقَدِّرُ مِنَ العِزِّ وَيُؤَدِّي مِنَ الإِخضاعِ، وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَغِبُ عَنِ الأَجالِ وَيُقَدِّرُ مِنَ السَّلامِ، وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُشَرِّفُ مِنَ الأَزَلِ وَيُقَدِّرُ مِنَ العِزِّ، وَهُوَ الأَعلىُ الَّذِي يَغِبُ عَنِ الأَجالِ وَيُقَدِّرُ مِنَ الإِخضاعِ، وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَغِبُ عَنِ الأَعيُنِ وَيُقَدِّرُ مِنَ القَدرِ، وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَغِبُ عَنِ الأَجالِ وَيُقَدِّرُ مِنَ السَّلامِ

data.cultural_impact: The name "Muraaqib" may hold various cultural meanings depending on the region and cultural context. However, a common thread is the sense of responsibility and commitment it conveys. It is a name for someone who is tasked with the duty of observation, monitoring, and keeping watch over something or someone. This concept can be seen in various aspects of Islamic culture, such as the role of a "Musaqab" in the police force, or the "Mashaweer" (watchmen) in the mosque who keep an eye on the building and its premises during prayer times.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Muraaqib" is a reminder of the constant observation and accountability that we have towards Allah (SwT). As the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) once said, "Allah does not look at your faces but rather at your hearts and deeds." Thus, the name Muraaqib signifies the need to be mindful of our actions, words, and thoughts at all times, as Allah (SwT) is the eternal observer. It also emphasizes the importance of striving towards obedience to Allah, as we are constantly being watched and evaluated. Therefore, every individual strives to be a "Muraaqib" in their own circumstances, striving towards the path of righteousness and seeking Allah's pleasure in all their actions.
